If exp89r (CI) goes at 00:05 UTC, exp89r - exp89p = DIS + CI, which needs a double difference with probe 51 (exp87a - exp85a). At 0.001 rounding that cannot resolve a 0.0007 effect. Hard-coding 'tie drops DIS' from non-transferable evidence tilts the tie against the only formula-backed private-side argument. Net: this is a restatement of the 12:23Z status ('direction from the formula, not a read') with a mis-weighted prior.
